purpose: Templates allowed into the first isolated Cloud Run deployment (POC). Blank lender forms only: no client data. Each entry is SHA-256 pinned and needs a recorded human approval before tools/stage_deploy.py will stage it.

templates.why: Acceptance goal: generate the BNZ Boarder PDF on Cloud Run from a synthetic payload.
templates.approvalScope: Packaging and testing the blank BNZ Boarder Form template in the isolated POC deployment, with synthetic data only. Does NOT authorize marking adviser certifications, completing declarations, applying signatures, accessing real client data or deploying additional bank forms.
